qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Tier one admits only the exact four-byte, one-instruction RAX-based memory BTR at the measured fixture RIP with R14 as its bit index. The same operation at an adjacent RIP declines.
admission.matcherHardening: The older measured RCX-indexed BTR matcher now also requires its exact four-byte, one-instruction, one-statement RAX-base shape.
admission.transactionality: The signed bit-string path performs one replay-safe qword read and one final transactional write. CF and memory publish only after the write commits.
admission.deferred: Every other R14-indexed or unmeasured memory BTR remains interpreter-owned.

verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,452 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Signed indexes 0, 64, and -1 and both selected-bit states match the interpreter exactly in architectural state and memory; the older RCX matrix covers 0, 63, 64, -1, and -65 plus failed-write rollback.
verification.negativeCoverage: The identical R14 encoding at the adjacent RIP declines.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The candidate produced 2,227 more tier-one attempts and different interrupt, cache, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. The elapsed and decline differences are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

interpretation: The measured R14 memory-BTR site is absent from the retained negative-cache sample and the authenticated workload completes. A05.2 remains open because 127,757 of 226,462 full-run tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
